milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The target block is at relative position (6, 1, 6) from spawn (~8.5 blocks away diagonally). Max distance of 4 ensures the player actually navigated to it rather than satisfying it trivially from spawn. Facing tolerance of 45° confirms the player is looking at the block.

Uses inventory_has because acquiring treasure means items from the chest end up in the player's inventory. Checking for 3 diamonds since they are the most distinctive treasure item, are not in starting inventory, and confirm the player successfully opened and looted the chest at ~12,0,12.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The white terracotta pillar (3-high) is at relative position (-8, 1, 5) in the northwest zone (~9.4 blocks from spawn). Max distance of 5 ensures intentional navigation to the landmark. Facing tolerance of 60° confirms visual identification.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta terracotta pillar (3-high) is at relative position (10, 1, -5) in the eastern zone (~11.2 blocks from spawn). Max distance of 5 ensures intentional navigation. Facing tolerance of 60° confirms visual identification of the landmark.

Uses inventory_has because mining white stained glass with the provided Silk Touch pickaxe drops the block itself into inventory. Checking for min_count=1 confirms the mining action was performed. The white stained glass wall (24 blocks at ~-10 to ~-7, y1-3, z7-8) provides ample supply.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted pink stained glass ends up in the player's inventory. Recipe: 8 clear glass blocks + 1 pink dye → 8 pink stained glass. Both ingredients sourced from the treasure chest. Checking for 8 matches the recipe output quantity.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted birch sign ends up in the player's inventory. Recipe: 6 birch planks (from white terracotta zone, 8 available) + 1 stick (from chest) → 3 birch signs. Checking for min_count=1 since having any birch sign confirms successful crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted acacia pressure plate ends up in the player's inventory. Recipe: 2 acacia planks (from magenta terracotta zone, 4 available) → 1 acacia pressure plate. Not in starting inventory so presence confirms crafting.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted diamond axe ends up in the player's inventory. Recipe: 3 diamonds + 2 sticks (both from treasure chest) → 1 diamond axe. Not in starting inventory so presence confirms successful crafting.
